# ap-discover-targetname

<!-- Generated By: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5[1m]) -->

Assign target names to light frames that have none, using the nearest target by mount RA/DEC from a reference imaging train.

## Overview

On a dual rig, the second camera often captures continuously with no target set, so its frames have no `OBJECT` header. Both cameras share the mount, so both write the same `RA`/`DEC`.

Each target in the reference directory gets one position: the median of its LIGHT frames' positions on the sphere. For each LIGHT frame in the source directory, the tool finds the nearest target by angular separation. If within `--max-separation`, it renames the frame to append `_OBJECT_<target>`:

```text
2026-10-14_08-12-10_HFR_2.77_RMSAC_0.00_TEMP_26.00.fits
2026-10-14_08-12-10_HFR_2.77_RMSAC_0.00_TEMP_26.00_OBJECT_Cocoon Nebula.fits
```

Key features:
- Mosaic panels are separate targets, each with its own position
- Frames with no match (slews, parked, between targets) are left unchanged
- Frames already renamed are skipped, so re-runs are quiet
- Dry-run mode to preview renames

## Pipeline Position

Run against the raw secondary frames, before the rest of the pipeline:

1. `ap-discover-targetname` appends `OBJECT_<target>` to the filenames
2. `ap-preserve-header --include OBJECT` writes `OBJECT` from the filename into the header
3. `ap-move-raw-light-to-blink` organizes by target

## Installation

```bash
python -m pip install git+https://github.com/jewzaam/ap-discover-targetname.git
```

## Usage

```bash
# Preview, with separations, to tune --max-separation
python -m ap_discover_targetname /raw/secondary /raw/primary --dryrun --debug

# Rename
python -m ap_discover_targetname /raw/secondary /raw/primary
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `source_dir` | Directory of frames missing a target (searched recursively) |
| `reference_dir` | Directory of frames defining the targets (searched recursively) |
| `--max-separation DEG` | Max degrees to the nearest reference target (default: 1.0) |
| `--max-reference-lights N` | Max reference frames used per target and panel (default: all) |
| `--dryrun` | Print the renames without renaming |
| `--debug` | Enable debug output, including per-frame RA/DEC and separation |
| `--quiet`, `-q` | Suppress non-essential output |
| `--log-file PATH` | Write log output to a file; errors still print to the terminal |
